class.name: NetwPredictRecoveryRequest
class.brief_description: A write-only staging area for the facts one recovery decision is computed from, filled once and handed to the call that plans a [NetwPredictWritePlan] from it.
class.description: Holds no accessors of its own: [method fill] is the entire public surface, and the fields it fills are read only by whichever call consumes it. A caller gathers everything a recovery decision needs about one out-of-sync field set into a single request rather than threading eighteen loose arguments through the call that plans the correction.

method.name: fill
method.description: Stages one recovery request. [param predicted], [param authority], and [param current] are per-field state rows: what the local prediction held at [param basis], what authority held there, and what the field holds right now. [param field_errors] is the divergence already measured per field. [param policy] is a [code]RecoveryPolicy[/code]: [code]0[/code] rebase by replay, [code]1[/code] rebase by direct recovery, [code]2[/code] delay because the owner declared it never speculates and is closed to rebase, or [code]3[/code] observe without correcting at all. [param fallback_epsilon] and [param fallback_teleport] are the divergence and teleport thresholds a field without its own override inherits. [param max_restore_ticks] caps how long a restore may stretch, [param ack_age_ticks] is the acknowledgment age the correction is priced against, and [param collision_cooldown_ticks] is how long a further collision-triggered recovery is suppressed after this one. [param tick_delta] converts tick counts to seconds for that pricing. [param domain] and [param attribution] carry this divergence's classification, [param contact_window] marks whether it fell inside a contact window, [param suppressed] forces the recovery to skip outright, and [param pose_unmeasured] marks that pose evidence was missing, which forces an escalation regardless of the measured error. Calling this again overwrites the previous fill entirely.
